description: Boot a QEMU virtual machine with KVM hardware acceleration. Auto-detects optimal resource allocation: uses total cores minus 1 for the VM (reserving one for the host OS), and up to 65% of physical RAM. Custom values are accepted but capped at safe limits to prevent host starvation.

adbPort.description: Host port to forward to guest ADB (port 5555). Default 5556.

append.description: Kernel command line arguments (for Android boot).

cpus.description: Virtual CPUs. Auto-detected if omitted (total cores minus 1). Capped at safe limit.

display.description: Display output. 'none' for headless (default). 'vnc' starts a VNC server on port 5900.

image.description: Disk image filename (from adb_qemu_images) or absolute path

initrd.description: Path to initrd/ramdisk image (for Android boot).

kernel.description: Path to kernel image (for Android boot). If omitted, QEMU uses the disk image's bootloader.

memoryMb.description: RAM in MB. Auto-detected if omitted (65% of physical RAM). Capped at safe limit.

name.description: VM name (used to track and stop the VM)

name: adb_qemu_start
